class.name: harambe_ethercat_driver/HarambeEthercatDriver
class.description: CSP/CST EtherCAT driver for Harambe humanoid with nonlinear ankle linkage transform. Command layout: position, effort, mode_of_operation. Inherits ethercat_driver/EthercatDriver and adds eccentric-pushrod kinematics for the differential ankle mechanism (2 motors → pitch/roll).

class.name: harambe_ethercat_driver/HarambePvtDriver
class.description: PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) EtherCAT driver for Harambe humanoid with nonlinear ankle linkage transform. Command layout: position, velocity, effort, kp, kd (kp/kd per-motor passthrough). Shares the ankle kinematics with the CSP/CST driver via AnkleLinkageDriver.
